gold_row.question: Output all measurements from sensor 8.0 in epoch 65.
gold_row.gold_answer: mote_id=8 time=2004-02-28T01:30:16.570353 temperature=18.7144 humidity=40.3652 light=108.56 voltage=2.68742
gold_row.gold_cypher:
MATCH (s:Sensor {mote_id: 8})-[:GENERATED]->(m:Measurement)
MATCH (m)-[:EPOCH_IN]->(e:Epoch {epoch_id: 65})
WITH m, s
RETURN coalesce(s.mote_id, m.moteid, m.mote_id) AS mote_id, m.time AS time, m.temperature AS temperature, m.humidity AS humidity, m.light AS light, m.voltage AS voltage ORDER BY time, mote_id LIMIT 20
